'''Ranso Li''' was a [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] who worked for [[Nirama]],<ref name="TF" /> an [[Oblee]]<ref name="Recursion">{{LivingForce|Belted In: Recursion}}</ref> [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] who operated a [[Organization|smuggling concern]] in the [[Cularin system/Legends|Cularin system]].<ref name="TF" /> In [[19 ABY/Legends|19 ABY]], during the reign of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]],<ref name="Scourge">[[Scourge (novel)|''Scourge'']]</ref> Li and the Twi'lek [[Cruva Lenda]] traveled from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Cularin/Legends|Cularin]] to the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]] to acquire some fast, second-hand [[Freighter/Legends|freighters]] for use by Nirama's organization. There, the pair attended a banquet that was held by the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Popara Anjiliac Diresto]] inside [[Popara's penthouse]],<ref name="TF" /> in honor of the Hutt's guests [[Eddey Be'ray]], [[Reen Irana]], and [[Mander Zuma]].<ref name="Scourge" />

During Popara's party, Li spoke to some of the other guests about the Cularin [[Star system/Legends|system's]] merits as a tourist destination. Li was [[Language/Legends|multi-lingual]] and could speak [[Galactic Basic Standard/Legends|Basic]], [[Huttese/Legends|Huttese]], and [[Twi'leki/Legends|Twi'leki]]. The Twi'lek wore high-quality clothing and carried a [[Blaster pistol/Legends|blaster pistol]] and a [[Datapad/Legends|datapad]].<ref name="TF" />

==Behind the scenes==
Ranso Li was created by [[Jeff Grubb]] and [[Owen K.C. Stephens]], and appeared in the [[2002]] paperback [[Star Wars Roleplaying Game|role-playing]] supplement ''[[Tempest Feud]]''. The book includes a seating plan for Popara's party, showing that during the event, one of Nirama's Twi'lek [[Agent/Legends|agents]] sat a table with the [[Corporate Sector Authority/Legends|Corporate Sector Authority]] representative [[Miltar Dolor]], the Hutt [[Lungru Nokko Vimmas|Lungru]], and the [[Cerean/Legends|Cerean]] [[Kir Sesad]], while the other Twi'lek sat with Popara's son [[Mika Anjiliac Chiera|Mika]] and some [[Bimm (furred species)/Legends|Bimms]]. However, the adventure does not specify which of the seating placements applied to Li, and which one applied to Lenda. The supplement also does not reveal Li's [[Gender/Legends|gender]]. While ''Tempest Feud'' has no timeline setting and as such can take place in any publishing era,<ref name="TF" /> [[Scourge (novel)|''Scourge'']]&mdash;a novelization of the events of ''Tempest Feud'' that was written by Grubb and released in [[2012]]&mdash;revealed that the events of the adventure are set in 19 ABY, thus making the New Republic era the period in which Li lived. Furthermore, Li and Lenda make a possible appearance in ''Scourge'', which notes that a pair of [[Gender/Legends|male]] Twi'leks were in attendance at Popara's party.<ref name="Scourge" />
